goal.created/member/reply_schema.statement: SP-298 final disclosure boundary: the reply must be the owner's closed MemberSuccessV1 (value typed by member suffix). Every input reaching it with a bad value is first refused by the phase or value-present rows, so it is never the sole refusal; it is closed by the same declared duplicate sets, whose joint cut accepts while each site refuses alone.

goal.created/member/value_present.statement: SP-298 member role: a null member value is refused as member_unavailable. It refuses only together with the earlier phase row (a no-effect or unknown row holds no creation receipt) or the row-presence row, so it is never the sole refusal and its gated table cannot be run; it is closed by the declared duplicate sets (phase, value_present, reply_schema) and (row_present, value_present, reply_schema), whose joint cut makes the complete resolver accept while each site still refuses alone.
